Ardon Jashari.note: Jashari's edge is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Ardon Jashari.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Aurele Amenda.note: Amenda's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Aurele Amenda.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Breel Embolo.note: Embolo stands out for making the next teammate's action easier. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Breel Embolo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是让队友下一步处理更轻松。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Cedric Itten.note: Itten is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Cedric Itten.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Christian Fassnacht.note: Fassnacht's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Christian Fassnacht.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Dan Ndoye.note: Ndoye's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Dan Ndoye.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Denis Zakaria.note: Zakaria is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Denis Zakaria.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Djibril Sow.note: Sow is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Djibril Sow.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Eray Coemert.note: Cömert stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Eray Coemert.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Fabian Rieder.note: Watch Rieder for repeatable technique on dead balls. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Fabian Rieder.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是定位球上稳定而多变的脚法。留意他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Granit Xhaka.note: Xhaka is defined by keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Granit Xhaka.noteZh: 他靠压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Gregor Kobel.note: Kobel's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Gregor Kobel.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Johan Manzambi.note: Manzambi is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Johan Manzambi.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Luca Jaquez.note: Jaquez's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Luca Jaquez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Manuel Akanji.note: Akanji is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Manuel Akanji.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Marvin Keller.note: Keller stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Marvin Keller.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Michel Aebischer.note: Watch Aebischer for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Michel Aebischer.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Miro Muheim.note: Muheim's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Miro Muheim.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nico Elvedi.note: Elvedi's signature is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Nico Elvedi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Noah Okafor.note: Okafor is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Noah Okafor.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Remo Freuler.note: Freuler stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Remo Freuler.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ricardo Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez is defined by keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Ricardo Rodriguez.noteZh: 他靠压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定与同位置球员拉开差异。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ruben Vargas.note: Vargas's edge is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ruben Vargas.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Silvan Widmer.note: Watch Widmer for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Silvan Widmer.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Yvon Mvogo.note: Mvogo is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Yvon Mvogo.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Zeki Amdouni.note: Amdouni stands out for making the next teammate's action easier. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Zeki Amdouni.noteZh: 他的突出特点是让队友下一步处理更轻松。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。
